acceptance_predicates.description: The TUI renders only a validated, generation-bound ASB catalog of installable tools, agents, and workloads, including truthful installed, unavailable, prerequisite, and lifecycle states.

First-run and reconfiguration routes provide keyboard-accessible search, checkable multi-selection, separated summary/details, contextual help, and conventional navigation for each installable category.
Every install, cancel, retry, refresh, and status action is a typed ASB control request; the TUI performs no local acquisition, compilation, package-manager, shell, secret, or provenance operation.
Per-item progress and terminal outcomes are bounded, actionable, generation/request bound, and refresh the authoritative setup catalog after success without implicit selection.
The formal UI model, generated artifact, help catalog, module inventory, deterministic state/render/PTY coverage, and UI parity gates cover every route and lifecycle state.
Exact paired integration, independent exact-head review, signed-DCO history, required CI, merge, and post-merge installed-PTY qualification pass.

definition_of_done: A user can select supported tools, agents, and workloads in asb-tui, have ASB install them, observe truthful lifecycle progress, and continue configuration from a refreshed authoritative catalog.

inputs.description: Versioned ASB installation catalog and lifecycle control operations for tools, agents, and workloads.
Current asb-tui first-run and reconfiguration wizard with authoritative catalog binding.

outputs.description: Reviewed asb-tui installation route, state projection, help, formal model, and regression coverage.
Privacy-safe installed PTY journey receipt binding exact ASB and asb-tui heads.

gates.description: Validated catalog and typed lifecycle request/result projection tests pass.
PTY journey covers first-run and reconfiguration selection, progress, cancellation, retry, refresh, and return to setup.
Formal-model, help, source/module inventory, and visual parity checks pass.
Exact paired ASB/asb-tui review, required CI, merge, and post-merge installed-PTY validation pass.
